slides.headline: Build your own *AI chief of staff*

slides.title: The problem
slides.subtitle: Meeting notes and follow-ups kept *slipping*.
slides.body: Recordings were inconsistent and everything had to be copied and pasted by hand. So Quinn asked: what if a loop ran every morning and pulled it all together?

slides.headline: Sources + connectors: *plug into what you already use*
Runs at *8 AM*, laptop closed. Ends in *a brief*.

slides.title: Close the loop
slides.subtitle: The brief is a *two-way* conversation.
slides.body: At the end of the day, reply with what happened. The agent updates your to-dos and Asana, so tomorrow's brief starts from reality.

slides.title: Start this week
slides.subtitle: Keep version one small:
slides.body: Pick two sources. Write one prompt playbook. Schedule it for 8 AM. Ask for a five-bullet brief. Add sources once you trust it.
